evidence_tier: post hoc, exploratory. Cannot change any locked verdict (formal development gates, holdout NI FAIL 3/3, formal MIL NO_CONTROL_SUPERIORITY, post-hoc MIL A/B, mechanism H_map partial / H_gain reversed). All outcomes are reported whatever their direction.
motivation: Manuscript section 7.2 states that the non-equivalence may partly reflect criterion windows mis-specified relative to the measured onset. E1 tests this directly by re-adapting COISC with windows set from fit-split onsets. E2 tests on fresh seeds whether the seed-2 pattern (COISC corrected all 72 wrong-direction first moves of R0, matched fine-tuning L0 corrected none) recurs and whether a pre-deployment first-action check can decide when to apply the adaptation.
prior_exposure_disclosure: Holdout first-change onsets of T_p (10,10,20,30,20 s on 5 selection+holdout events) and T6 (60,40,80 s), and the holdout lag reanalysis (manuscript Figure 5, Supplementary Tables S2-S3), were seen before this draft.
Holdout pulse profiles were seen: the R0 T_p response is predominantly negative at 20-40 s; original COISC reduced this lobe to about one third without correcting its sign.

All MIL results for seeds 20260922/23/24 were seen, including the seed-2 wrong-direction first moves in scenarios S04/S07/S08 (72 pairs) and the 24 non-correct first moves of original COISC on seed 3.
Fit-split event onsets (tables below) were read on 2026-10-04 before this draft; they are model-independent measurements.
The holdout set is reused. E1 and E2 holdout results are therefore not independent confirmation.

lag_window_rule.source: results/development/B4_seed20260922/excitation_event_metrics.csv, split == fit only (23 events, 3 increases and 20 decreases; 17 from dual-cycle runs holding each level 60 s). true_onset_s is the paper_eval.onset first-change detector at 10-s resolution and does not depend on any model.
lag_window_rule.rule: tau_new_j = min(prior_j, fit_onset_median_j). Windows are only shortened, never lengthened, preserving the original rationale that the shortest lag is the conservative choice for a pre-lag penalty. Transition band g = 10 s, eps_pre, eps_sign unchanged.
lag_window_rule.declared_expectation_before_running: For T_p the pre-lag set becomes empty and 20-30 s fall in the unconstrained band, so only the 40-s part of the negative lobe is directly constrained. The 20-s part, previously shrunk as pre-lag leakage, is no longer penalized and may remain negative or grow. A partial or null change of the early lobe is a plausible outcome.

lambda_rule: Recalibrate lambda once with the unchanged screen.calibrate rule (two discarded fit-only 32-step pilots, seed 20260922, min(0.10*mean(pred)/mean(reg), 0.20*min batch ratio)) using the new masks, as done for the ablation variants. The value is shared by all seeds and written into the frozen record before any adaptation.

variants.R0: existing checkpoints for seeds 20260922/23/24; trained with the unchanged protocol for E2 seeds
variants.COISC: original method (prior masks, lambda 939.1430335805455), included for E2 seeds only
variants.COISC_onset: identical to COISC (head only, 75 steps, batch 128, lr 5e-5, Adam, same seed handling) except tau_new masks and the recalibrated lambda
variants.L0: identical 75-step head-only fine-tuning with lambda = 0 (matched fine-tuning control)
variants.COISC_onset_lamprior: E1 only, diagnostic: tau_new masks with the prior lambda 939.1430335805455, to separate the window change from the lambda change. Development and holdout only, no MIL.

E1_existing_seeds.models: COISC_onset and COISC_onset_lamprior adapted from the existing R0 selected.pt of each seed (checkpoint sha256 verified before adaptation)
E1_existing_seeds.development_gates_reported: the four per-seed selection gates of the formal protocol, computed with tau_new masks (Tp_120s_MAE <= R0 + 0.005; PLE not defined for T_p and reported as NA; WSR <= 0.9 x R0; PSM >= max(0.2 x R0, 0.0005)). Gates are reported; all stages run regardless (no stopping), because the purpose is to measure, not to select.

holdout_endpoints.H1_WSR_Tp_new: source-equal WSR of T_p over post cells 40-120 s, COISC_onset vs paired R0 and vs original COISC
holdout_endpoints.H2_PSM_Tp_new: source-equal PSM of T_p over 40-120 s, ratio to R0
holdout_endpoints.H3_early_lobe: median S_Tp and fraction negative at 10-60 s (Supplementary Table S3 format)
holdout_endpoints.H4_T6: WSR and PSM of T6 over 90-120 s
holdout_endpoints.H5_accuracy: T_p MAE difference at 10/30/60/90/120 s with the frozen 20,000-draw source bootstrap (seed 20260926); NI at 0.005 C reported with the known resolution (SE 0.013-0.030, power 4-6 %)
holdout_endpoints.H6_comparability: all sensitivity metrics also under the prior masks and the existing lag-reanalysis scenarios (measured onsets, tau = 30 s, all steps)

E1_existing_seeds.MIL: same bench, runner and analysis as POSTHOC_MIL (24 plants x 12 scenarios = 288 pairs per seed): 864 new COISC_onset runs. Existing R0/COISC/L0/ORACLE runs are reused after a reproduction gate (gate R5). Endpoints: family-equal Delta MAE vs R0 with cluster bootstrap, first-action split, G120/G600.

E2_fresh_seeds.trainer_gate: before E2, retrain R0 for seed 20260922 with the unchanged trainer; the selected.pt sha256 must equal the existing checkpoint, otherwise stop and report
E2_fresh_seeds.holdout: inference-only diagnostics and accuracy for all four models (as E1)
E2_fresh_seeds.first_action_check: plant-free: for each checkpoint, solve the first MPC step on the 12 locked scenario initial states with the unchanged formal MPC controller (control_mpc.MPCController, horizon 12, SLSQP); correct = raise u_h if initial T_p < 37 C, lower if above. Computed for all four models.
E2_fresh_seeds.MIL: full 288-pair bench for R0, COISC_onset and L0 (8,640 runs, about 12 h on 6 workers), plus R0_GUARD runs on R0 wrong-direction pairs (see direction_guard_arm). Original COISC: first-action check and holdout only.

questions.Q1_incidence: number of fresh seeds whose R0 has at least one wrong-direction first move
questions.Q2_repair: among R0 wrong-direction scenarios, fraction corrected by COISC_onset, COISC and L0; Delta MAE in those pairs
questions.Q3_harm: among R0 correct scenarios, fraction made wrong or zero by each model; Delta MAE in those pairs
questions.Q4_policy: pre-specified deployment policy: use COISC_onset for a checkpoint if its R0 makes any wrong-direction first move on the 12 check states, else keep R0. Compare policy vs always-R0 and vs always-L0-under-same-trigger, family-equal MAE, pooled over triggered seeds with plant-family cluster bootstrap.

E2_fresh_seeds.assessability_rule: if fewer than 2 of the 10 fresh seeds trigger, Q2/Q4 are reported as not assessable and only Q1/Q3 are reported
E2_fresh_seeds.circularity_note: the first-action check uses the same 12 initial states as the evaluation. It is a legitimate online check (the first action depends only on the initial state and the internal model) but not an out-of-sample predictor of later tracking.

direction_guard_arm.decision: included (decided 2026-10-03) so that any E2 benefit of COISC_onset can be compared with a trivial action-sign rule
direction_guard_arm.definition: R0_GUARD = R0 inside the unchanged MPC, except at the first control step only: if sign(u_h[0] - previous u_h) is strictly opposite to sign(37 C - initial T_p), the applied command is quantize(previous u_h) (hold). All later steps are the unchanged MPC decisions, which receive the held command as their previous command. A zero first move is left unchanged.
direction_guard_arm.labelling_note: the guard and the first-action correctness label both use the logged initial T_p of the scenario, which is available before the first move. This is a commissioning-time check, not closed-loop T_p feedback (the controller still has none).
direction_guard_arm.runs: only (seed, scenario) pairs where R0's first action is wrong-direction, x 24 plants; for all other pairs R0_GUARD equals R0 by construction. E1: existing seeds (seed 20260923: 3 scenarios, 72 runs). E2: all triggered fresh seeds.
direction_guard_arm.identity_spot_check: for each seed with at least one R0_GUARD run, the lowest-index non-triggered scenario x plants 0 and 12 is also run with the guard (R0_GUARD_ID); it must not fire and must equal the R0 run bitwise (applied u_h and plant T_p)
direction_guard_arm.question_Q5: on R0 wrong-direction pairs pooled over triggered seeds: family-equal Delta MAE of COISC_onset minus R0_GUARD and of L0 minus R0_GUARD, cluster bootstrap with the shared draws; also policy (COISC_onset when triggered) vs guard-always

reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.R1_calibration: the copied calibrate with prior masks reproduces lambda 939.1430335805455 and the 16 stored pilot regularizer records exactly; lambda_onset is computed in the same pass (pilot training does not depend on the masks) and written into the frozen record
reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.R2_adaptation: the copied adaptation with prior masks reproduces formal coisc_final.pt bitwise for all three existing seeds
reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.R3_trainer: R0 retrained for seed 20260922 has a state_dict bitwise equal to the existing selected.pt (E2 trainer gate)
reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.R4_holdout: recomputed holdout predictions/sensitivities of existing R0, COISC and L0 match the stored delivered-23 records within 1e-5
reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.R5_MIL_runner: 12 existing R0 runs of seed 20260923 (plant 2k, scenario k, k = 0..11) re-executed with onset_mil.run_one are bitwise equal to the formal raw runs (applied u_h and plant T_p); the plant-free first decision of existing R0, COISC and L0 (3 seeds x 12 scenarios) equals the first applied u_h of all 24 formal/post-hoc MIL runs; the runner previous command equals the logged previous u_h exactly; guard unit test on synthetic decisions; guard identity preview on 2 non-triggered seed-20260923 runs
reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.R6_MIL_analysis: onset_analyze reproduces the formal COISC minus R0 contrast and the post-hoc MIL A1 (COISC - L0) and A2 (L0 - R0) contrasts for the three existing seeds exactly (point and CI); selftest with relabelled already-reported runs returns the known answers
reproduction_gates_before_any_new_result.stop_rule: any gate failure stops execution and is reported; no change of rules to make a gate pass

interpretation_rules_declared_before_run.E1_window_explanation_supported: H1 WSR <= 0.9 x R0 on all 3 seeds and H2 PSM >= 0.2 x R0, AND H5 accuracy point estimate not worse than original COISC on at least 2 of 3 seeds
interpretation_rules_declared_before_run.E1_window_explanation_not_supported: H1 fails on 2 or more seeds, or windows are met but accuracy and MIL are no better than original COISC; the manuscript then states that window alignment did not change the conclusion
interpretation_rules_declared_before_run.E2_conditional_benefit: Q4 policy Delta MAE vs always-R0 with cluster-bootstrap upper bound < 0 over triggered seeds, AND COISC_onset corrects more R0 wrong first moves than L0 in at least 2 triggered seeds

code_changes_required_at_implementation: screen.lag_masks/regularizer: pass the lag list explicitly (default unchanged); verify the default path reproduces the original masks bit for bit
new runner formal_coisc_onset.py (copy of formal_coisc.py with tau_new, recalibrated lambda, new seeds, L0 and COISC_onset), new output root; original files untouched
holdout evaluation wrapper with parameterized masks (lag_reanalysis.masks already supports this)
MIL runner: new checkpoint bindings (path + sha256) in a new protocol; first-action-only mode for original COISC
anonymization: outputs use Seed labels, S01-S12, T1-T6/T_p and plant families F1-F4; source_id is never written
manuscript_use: none without explicit author approval. If approved: E1 enters section 6.5/7.2 and Supplementary S2; E2 enters section 6.6/7.1 and Supplementary S3, with this disclosure; Table S1 gains one row. Word budget requires about 150-250 words of cuts.
lambda_onset_note: Computed 2026-10-04 by gate R1 (same pass reproduced the prior lambda and all 16 pilot records exactly). Per-sampler values 9077.805330026704 (ordinary) and 7485.005103519812 (excitation); the minimum is used. About 8x the prior lambda because the initial regularizer value under the onset masks is smaller (shorter pre-lag windows, and longer post windows whose mean is diluted by non-violating cells); the rule scales lambda up to keep the same initial loss share.

mil_execution.tasks: E1: COISC_onset x 3 seeds x 288 pairs (864). E2: R0, COISC_onset, L0 x 10 seeds x 288 pairs (8640). R0_GUARD on every R0 wrong-direction (seed, scenario) x 24 plants for E1 and E2 seeds; R0_GUARD_ID identity runs. Existing E1 R0/COISC (formal) and L0 (post-hoc MIL) runs are reused (gate R5).
mil_execution.first_action_check: computed once at the start of execution, plant-free, for E1 R0/COISC/L0/COISC_onset and E2 R0/COISC/COISC_onset/L0; it fixes the R0_GUARD task list before any closed-loop run
mil_execution.execution_order: onset_train e1 -> onset_train e2 -> onset_holdout run -> onset_mil execute 6 -> onset_analyze analyze
mil_execution.workers: 6 processes, 2 torch threads each, plants split by index modulo 6

analysis_operationalization.per_seed_contrasts: af.hierarchical_effect on the 12 x 4 family-equal matrix with the formal 20000 shared draws (default_rng(20260927)); E1: COISC_onset vs R0, COISC, L0; E2: COISC_onset vs R0, L0 vs R0, COISC_onset vs L0
analysis_operationalization.pooled_over_triggered_seeds: mean of the per-seed 12 x 4 matrices over triggered E2 seeds, then af.hierarchical_effect with the same draws (Q4, Q5 policy)
analysis_operationalization.subset_contrasts: unit = (seed, scenario) family-equal mean over the 24 primary plants; percentile CI from 20000 unit-bootstrap draws, rng default_rng(20261004) (Q2, Q3, Q5 pair contrasts)
analysis_operationalization.E1_rule: H1: Tp_WSR_ONSET ratio COISC_onset/R0 <= 0.9 on all 3 seeds; H2: Tp_PSM_ONSET ratio >= 0.2 on all 3 seeds; H5: Tp_MAE_120 COISC_onset - COISC <= 0 (point) on >= 2 seeds; MIL: E1 COISC_onset - COISC point < 0. Supported = H1 and H2 and H5. Not supported = H1 fails on >= 2 seeds, or H1 and H2 met while H5 and MIL each hold on < 2 seeds. Otherwise reported as mixed.
analysis_operationalization.E2_rule: E2_conditional_benefit = Q4 policy minus always-R0 CI upper < 0 AND COISC_onset corrects more R0 wrong first moves than L0 in >= 2 triggered seeds; not assessable if < 2 triggered seeds
analysis_operationalization.execution_checks: R7 guard identity; guard fired on every R0_GUARD run; plant-free first decision equals the first applied u_h of every run of that checkpoint

execution_authorization_rule: onset_train e1/e2, onset_holdout run, onset_mil execute and onset_analyze analyze require EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.json written on the author's explicit instruction, naming this file's SHA-256
